entries./workout/:id: From athlete plan/history or authorized workout notification.
entries./deliver/:id: Published-program action; id is immutable version ID.

entries./workout-templates/:id: Library create/preview/edit; new is a dedicated creation route, staff only.

links.reason: Role-specific item arrays drive base + item[0]. Athlete, coach and administrator arrays differ; hidden items are not permissions.
Current context path comes from auth normalization; empty public instance opens setup, initialized instance sign-in.
safeNext accepts internal next paths; otherwise normalized context opens dashboard/access. This does not grant arbitrary target authority.
Successful setup opens normalized administrator context; initialized setup redirects to sign-in.
After token acknowledgement the normalized context path decides the destination.
listPath plus new, exercise ID or recovered draft ID drives dedicated editor navigation.
listPath depends on group/template route; new, existing and resumed editor IDs stay in the same catalog kind. Template creation may return via account/institution/event-scoped BroadcastChannel.
Back link preserves athlete member query. Result rows and chart points display values without opening event details.
Authorized profile sections provide subject-scoped detail/action links; backPath only accepts the People route with its query.
Athlete rows open own recorder; staff rows open coach review. Query-only search/page changes stay on this route.
item.href comes from notificationTarget after recipient/source authorization in server/notifications.ts. Retired independent sources are suppressed.

href is supplied by the caller. AnalyticsPage supplies People/Training links and TrainerDelivery supplies Schedule; AssessmentHistory supplies no chart links. Edges belong to the caller, not every chart consumer.
Brand destination is normalized auth context; utility links and operator/development items are conditional. All route screens inherit shell utilities.
back object carries Training path and the current view/search query.
base is the canonical Messages route. Directory clicks and acknowledged conversation creation append the authorized channel ID.
base returns to the conversation list; no standalone message-thread route exists.
Acknowledged start replaces new with the durable session ID using the current empty institution URL base.
returnPath is the own Training view after completion or back navigation.
Chart items receive the current institution Schedule path as href.
An acknowledged admin reset issues an out-of-band password setup URL, not an automatic navigation. Account fields and token validation remain server-owned.
Server-authorized per-participant result IDs; recording is coach-only.
Template identity links and explicit independent program copy.
